Jade_XinZhao.name: Xin Zhao
Jade_XinZhao.lore:
- Challenge (Passive) is moved from R to occupy the Passive slot
- Battle Cry (W) is a different ability, read the description
- Audacious Charge (E) no longer increases attack speed or extends range of ability
- Crescent Sweep (R) grants Armor and MR instead of damage immunity
Jade_XinZhao.blurb:
- Challenge (Passive) is moved from R to occupy the Passive slot
- Battle Cry (W) is a different ability, read the description
- Audacious Charge (E) no longer increases attack speed or extends range of ability
- Crescent Sweep (R) grants Armor...

spells.name: Three Talon Strike
spells.description: Xin Zhao's next 3 standard attacks deal increased damage that reduce his other ability cooldowns, with the third attack knocking an opponent into the air.
spells.tooltip: Xin Zhao's next 3 basic Attacks deal <physicalDamage>{{ totalbonusdamageperhit }} bonus physical damage</physicalDamage> and reduce his other abilities' cooldowns by 1 second. The final strike also <status>Knocks Up</status> for {{ knockupduration }} seconds.</mainText>{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Battle Cry
spells.description: Xin Zhao passively heals every 3 attacks and can activate this ability to attack faster.
spells.tooltip:
Passive: Xin Zhao heals himself for {{ totalhealamount }} every third basic attack.

Active: Xin Zhao unleashes a Battle Cry, increasing his Attack Speed by {{ attackspeedbonus*100 }}% for {{ duration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Audacious Charge
spells.description: Xin Zhao charges an enemy, dealing damage and slowing all enemies in the area.
spells.tooltip: Xin Zhao charges and <keywordMajor>Challenges</keywordMajor> an enemy. The charge deals <magicDamage>{{ totalmagicdamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> to all nearby enemies and <status>Slows</status> them by {{ slowamount }}% for {{ slowduration }} seconds. </mainText>{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Crescent Sweep
spells.description: Xin Zhao deals damage to nearby enemies based on their current Health and knocks non-challenged targets back. Xin Zhao gains bonus Armor and Magic Resist based on number of champions hit.
spells.tooltip: Xin Zhao unleashes a sweep around him that deals <physicalDamage>{{ totaldamage }} plus {{ percentcurrenthealthdamage*100 }}% current Health physical damage</physicalDamage> and <status>Knocks Back</status> all <keywordMajor>non-Challenged</keywordMajor> enemies. Xin Zhao gains {{ scalingresist }} <scaleArmor>Armor</scaleArmor> and <scaleMR>Magic Resist</scaleMR> for {{ resistduration }} seconds for each champion hit.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Challenge
passive.description: Xin Zhao challenges his target with his basic attacks and Audacious Charge, reducing its armor by 15% for 3 seconds.
